entities.summary: Stefan Valdobrev (b. 1970-05-20, Stara Zagora) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Stara Zagora and Bulgaria. Known in the fields of bulgaria, composers & musicians, europe.
